metadata.body:
Добавляет нормативный слой associativvordes/normative/ версии 1.0.0: пять определений, независимые процедуры членства, современной ассоциативной опоры и проверки необходимых порогов отбора, конечные национальные соответствия и append-only приоритет исторических ограничений.

Включены JSON Schema решений и национальных соответствий, машинные правила, валидатор, 27 объяснимых тестовых примеров и отчёт о 15 противоречиях между методологией, v5, v6 и разметкой. Тестовые метки не являются независимым gold или разрешениями на изменение данных. Внешняя проверка источников и полномочий обязательна; валидный JSON не удостоверяет лингвистическую истину. Доверенные разрешения привязаны к digest полного решения и каждого свидетельства: повторное использование ID после изменения содержимого отклоняется.

Проверка: node --test tests/associative-normative.test.mjs — 84 passed, 0 failed; node --check validator.mjs — passed. Проверены исходные blob hashes защищённых расчётных файлов и всех 26 файлов исторических решений v5. Добавлен отдельный CI job; тест также обнаруживается существующим npm test. Полный npm/browser/production прогон локально не выполнялся: использовались выборочно полученные закреплённые исходники.

Все 15 файлов — добавления. Production-семьи, memberships, aliases, формулы, веса и документ методологии не изменены. Новые корни не признаются, массовая очистка не запускается, runtime v5/v6 не переключается. Применение будущих решений остаётся за существующим release_control. Отчёты и границы проверки: audit/associative-family-normative/.

Независимый полный обход закреплённого main 47723611112610945cb09b34e18588b7bd151911 подтвердил 2 456 543 семьи, 10 078 319 memberships, 1 934 050 aliases и равенство source = materialized + unassigned: 4 924 980 = 4 924 281 + 699. Исходные lemma IDs восстановлены из первой полной Git-материализации; это не подмена оригинальных assignments.

Три полных census (основной, после реального восстановления архива и свежий измерительный) дали byte-identical FULL-CENSUS.json. Структурных повреждений, duplicate memberships, orphan targets и расхождений reverse aliases не найдено. Проверены 2 486 153 alias/family pairs, все stableLemmaId и объявленные hashes исторических decision ledgers. Legacy safe_automatic/verified не объявляются лингвистической сертификацией.

Снимок 4 306 файлов закреплён SHA-256 и размерами. Архив 1 475 102 720 bytes реально восстановлен с полной сверкой; шесть частей и manifest сохранены отдельно от временного рабочего каталога. Искусственное завершение внутри второй транзакции проверило rollback/resume. Дополнительно восстановлены checkpoints после реального заполнения диска; обе SQLite integrity_check=ok. Активные DB перенесены в /tmp для исключения фоновых копий WAL.

Свежий полный проход: 1089.276 s, peak RSS 255 552 KiB; полная база census — 972 914 688 bytes. 12 локальных тестов проходят; новый Node wrapper обнаруживается npm test, добавлен отдельный CI job. Полный npm/browser suite локально не запускался.

Статус: structural baseline PASS; полная сертификация upstream provenance BLOCKED. Original metadata/members artifacts возвращают 404; исходные assignments, raw candidate index/Kaikki и per-source license manifests недоступны. Эти ограничения явно сохранены в SOURCE-LOCK и INTEGRITY-REPORT. Исторические false memberships не восстановлены ради 699 unassigned.

Все изменения — новые инструменты, тесты и отчёты. Существующие family/member/alias данные, методологические формулы и production runtime не меняются. Основной отчёт: audit/associative-family-v5-baseline/V5-BASELINE-CERTIFICATION.md.

metadata.title: Add full v5 streaming evidence/review adapter with verified corpus receipts
metadata.body:
Production v5 memberships can now be investigated through the existing native evidence graph, review ledger, auto-annotation and finite mass-dry-run worker. Original family/lemma IDs, records, provenance and scoped historical constraints are preserved; legacy observations never become accepted memberships or lexical heads.

Two fresh builds traversed all 256 buckets (2,048 source gzip files), producing byte-identical databases and manifests. An independent decoder compared every field and ordinal across 2,456,543 families, 10,078,319 memberships and 1,934,050 aliases. All 35 pinned UDer/GLeMM/MorphyNet artifacts were indexed with original rows, native identities and dependency lineage.

A real 31-question six-language exercise runs graph/review/annotation, survives SIGKILL, resumes idempotently and exports through the existing mass-dry-run handoff. All proposals abstain: zero accepted memberships, new lexical heads, paid requests, human decisions or production writes. Checkpoint/resume, incremental rebuilding, deterministic IDs, finite cursor windows and checksum/sense forgery rejection have regression tests. Full run commands, benchmark and integrity/recovery receipts are in audit/associative-v5-adapter/V5-ADAPTER-REPORT.md.

Stacked on historical registry PR #681. Existing historical authority/scope holds and unavailable original assignment artifacts remain explicit blockers to automatic cleanup. No production family/member/alias data, old journals, normative formulas or calculation weights change. Raw datasets and large SQLite indexes remain outside Git.

Validation: 18 adapter tests; 47 annotation, 27 mass-dry-run, 23 history and 43 release-control regression tests; repository npm suite; full corpus comparison and fresh byte-identical rebuild. The build's measured maximum worker RSS was 58,604 KiB (two workers); independent verification peaked at 253,060 KiB. These are structural preservation results, not linguistic certification.

Full read-only diagnostics now covers all 256 production buckets: 2,456,543 families, 10,078,319 memberships, 1,934,050 aliases and 4,924,281 materialized legacy lemma IDs. Two independent full runs produced byte-identical SQLite databases and identical logical tables; per-bucket exact ID streams match without loss.

One observed origin category partitions every family; risk flags remain independent and overlapping. Complete affected sets are retained for 4,975 ending-diversity candidates, 5,982 exact duplicate-set groups, 281,198 alias fan-outs, shared legacy identities and large families. A separate complete indexed join against 252 configured tail tokens identifies 131 families/34,251 memberships, including long endings, and repeats byte-for-byte on the real restored registry. None of these signals is a linguistic deletion verdict.

Investigation is grouped into 21 mechanism cohorts, with four complete priority-band drill-down indexes, rather than millions of independent LLM jobs. All 10,078,319 linguistic membership statuses remain explicitly unresolved. Seven REGUL historical overlaps retain RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS authority and are not promoted to confirmed negatives. Existing history coverage/provenance blockers remain explicit.

Fresh full run: 2,161.966 seconds, peak RSS 339,316 KiB; output about 9.64 GB. Actual exit-75 recovery, committed-bucket resume contracts, full structural integrity, independent replay and real restoration of all 23 archive files passed. The 1,852,243,127-byte snapshot is preserved outside Git in five checksum-pinned volumes; full reconstruction was verified. Only small reports/manifests are committed.

See audit/associative-v5-diagnostics/GLOBAL-V5-DIAGNOSTICS.md for exact family/member counts, overlap unions, priority rationale, source-code causes, review-economy limits and reproduction/recovery commands.

Validation: 13 diagnostic contracts, 18 adapter regressions, Node wrapper and full npm test suite passed; both full corpus runs and exact backup restoration passed. metadata.body:
The v1 source-availability classifier used several relation types as a proxy for COMPETING_ANALYSES. That was too broad: direct derivation and suffixation can describe the same event, and inflection can coexist with derivation. Version 2 corrects **774,625 research labels**, preserving the frozen v1 census and every original source field. `CURRENT.json` selects the current semantic review; the old snapshot remains reproducible.

Full census: **2,456,543 families / 10,078,319 memberships**, all 256 buckets. V2 completely reprocesses the exact suspicious scope: **2,456,532 families / 10,078,175 memberships**; 144 memberships remain explicitly outside that scope. All selected rows are now **INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE** because their corpus↔native lexical/sense bindings and paths to the root are unresolved. No verified conflicts, corrections, or exclusions are manufactured from source absence or coexisting types.

Adds a proof-envelope validator for future independently reviewed relations: exact family/lemma/POS/sense scope, artifact/revision/language-scoped native endpoints, every intermediate step, explicit direction, locked original-row evidence, and documented compound parts/roles/segmentation/meaning. Final verdicts require a separately configured trusted registry receipt bound to the complete proposal SHA with CONFIRMED_MANUAL or INDEPENDENT_GOLD authority. Model confidence, booleans, research/engineering labels and OWNER_ACCEPTED_AT_RISK do not qualify. There is no default authority adapter or live corpus proof set.

Relation/type review always preserves membership and alternative support. Application has a separate fail-closed history guard. **Verified relation corrections and proposed membership exclusions: 0.** Unknown error counts remain unknown, rather than becoming zero measured errors.

Validation:
- Original full source audit: 35 pinned UDer/GLeMM/MorphyNet artifacts, independent normalization of every accepted row (9,404,044); 24 quarantined originals retained; GLeMM direction remains unknown and 4,915,497 inflections remain separate.
- Both complete v2 passes produced 517 byte-identical result/receipt files. Independent Node replay checked every selected ID, ordinal, word, source mask/count, history reference and unresolved reason. Source fields and alternatives are unchanged.
- Deliberate exit 75 before checkpoint publication resumed successfully.
- All seven historical negatives and exact neighbor scopes checked again without promoting research authority; all 262 current history overlaps retained. History application remains blocked while coverage is incomplete.
- Fresh SHA checks cover all 35 original artifacts, 35 raw SQLite indices, 35 profiles and all 2,051 production files. Production, old ledgers, association formulas, national correspondences and 699 unassigned records are unchanged.
- Adversarial proof/identity/authority tests and full npm test passed. V2 full/replay: 128.382/130.645 seconds; peak RSS 15,752/15,776 KiB.
- Real cold restore verified all 521 v2 archive files. New archive `interal-v5-morphology-semantic-v2.zip`: 250,220,094 bytes, SHA-256 `caff94aee051944487ba04a45cc1c0d18459bb66f1801067a972d6f2e53648a0`. Its dependency lock references the preserved durable v1 source archive.

metadata.title: Stage 09: sense-specific v5 semantic review with protected history and offline annotation
metadata.body:
Old v5 lemma IDs do not reliably distinguish homonyms, POS or senses. This adds a read-only semantic review layer that keeps documented dictionary meanings separate from corpus identity, historical decisions, assistant hypotheses and independent authority.

- Recounts all 256 buckets (2,456,543 families; 10,078,319 memberships), locks 2,051 production hashes, and exports all 58,821 memberships in 28 exact priority families across six languages.
- Captures 32 documentary contexts with 28 primary-source receipts plus three separate recheck sources; creates 67 sense-specific questions for 30 old records. Queues 27 records for sense disambiguation and two gene/Gen history conflicts. All other priority records remain explicitly unresolved; zero new exclusions or confirmations are asserted.
- Retains every matching native alternative from a full 9,404,068-row pass over 35 pinned morphology artifacts. Checks all 319 applicable imported historical scopes without authority promotion or broadened negatives.
- Integrates the existing auto_annotation journal/cache using a closed dictionary catalog. Offline only: 67 deterministic ABSTAIN, zero provider requests/tokens/costs and zero new human decisions. Independent corpus-sense binding, verified authority, history and correspondence guards block final proposals.
- Stores large research outputs outside Git in a persisted 21.6 MB archive; validates an actual cold restore of all 624 files and journal export equality. No production data, root forms or association formulas change.

Validation: all 106 npm test files pass; three semantic regression tests pass; independent JavaScript full-corpus verification, fresh deterministic replay, source hashes, interruption/resume and actual backup/restore pass. The documented remaining blockers are incomplete historical mapping, unresolved corpus senses and absent independent human gold. Structural verification is not linguistic certification.

Stacked on stage08 PR #688 because its protected correspondence registry is required. This PR must not be merged ahead of that dependency. Full report: audit/associative-v5-semantic-cleanup/SEMANTIC-CLEANUP-REPORT.md; reproduction commands: associativvordes/semantic_cleanup/README.md.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Condition current census claims on production tree equality**

When refreshed observations report a different production v5 tree, `compile_package` correctly blocks `PRODUCTION_MATCHES_RECORDED_BASELINE` but still copies the historical census into `current_unchanged` and `families_remaining_unchanged`, with a description asserting equal Git trees. The generated final audit consequently presents historical counts as the current unchanged registry even though that connection is no longer established. This occurs through the documented observation-refresh workflow and produces misleading audit results despite publication remaining blocked. Retain the historical `before` counts, but leave current counts unknown and adjust the report when tree equality fails.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate source inventory completeness against the pinned config**

If a package omits entries from `source.inputs`, the independent verifier checks only the remaining entries and never compares this inventory with `INPUTS.json`. Checking the configuration's hash later does not establish that its required inputs were checked. I reproduced this by setting `source.inputs` to an empty array, updating the source binding and package checksums, and running against a checkout containing the required code/configuration files but no audit inputs: verification still returned `PASS_BLOCKED_PACKAGE_BYTE_INTEGRITY`. Compare the complete source inventory with the pinned configuration's `files` list before checking individual files, so missing evidence cannot silently disappear from independent verification.
